description.text: 25th ANNIVERSARY GOLDEN BOX, made for the 25th anniversary of the Pokémon Card Game: a gold, Pikachu-themed set with a 60-card deck of holo cards led by a special gold Pikachu V, beside Pikachu VMAX and other Pikachu cards, premium sleeves, a foil-stamped rubber playmat, twelve metal damage dice, metal markers, faux-leather cases and five 25th Anniversary edition promo packs. Planned for 22 October 2021, it was moved to a lottery on Pokémon Center Online and shipped from winter 2021, with made-to-order production prepared in case the lottery drew enough entries.
